status: Biological palette direction accepted with later accessory, camouflage, size and facial-expression refinements; first production batch in development.
designRule: Keep the improved silhouettes, proportions, poses and facial acting. Base animal pigmentation on a real species reference, and use clothing/accessories to signal occupation. Use neutral daylight so a common warm grade does not turn the cast yellow/brown.

characters.biologicalBasis: Adult beluga whales are white to pale gray, with a rounded melon forehead, no dorsal fin and horizontal tail flukes. Keep the fictional face expressive while preserving this recognizable body plan.
characters.occupationAccent: Small cobalt-blue note satchel for the attentive Echo Caves sound explorer.

characters.biologicalBasis: Royal gramma coloration transitions from violet-purple at the head/anterior body to golden yellow at the posterior body and tail. Preserve its natural fish silhouette and use its clear color division for the pattern-host design.
characters.occupationAccent: Mint/cream puzzle notebook; lively mischievous expression, with no human limbs.

characters.biologicalBasis: Electric-blue bands on dark limbs, pale-speckled claws and orange antennae provide the reference. The carried gastropod shell has its own neutral natural markings.
characters.occupationAccent: Tangerine-orange postal pouch; cream envelope with a tangerine-orange scallop-shell seal.
characters.sourceNote: Western Australian Museum reef-crustacean survey, species photo caption on printed page160.

characters.biologicalBasis: A naturally red/reddish-brown octopus can change its color and mottling. Select a rich brick-red state with pale mottles, rather than inventing a uniformly blue animal.
characters.occupationAccent: Indigo denim work apron with restrained stitching and a stock crate for a practical shopkeeper.

characters.biologicalBasis: Longfin squid have a translucent base and reddish/pink/purple chromatophore patterning that can change. Pale silver is treated as a reflective highlight, not a fixed metallic pigment.
characters.occupationAccent: Cab-yellow/navy checked scarf and a small driver badge; yellow is kept on work accessories rather than the whole body.
characters.expression: Bored half-lidded eyes, relaxed brows and a flat closed mouth.

characters.biologicalBasis: The Atlantic spotted eagle ray has a dark/black upper surface with white spots, rings or dashes and a white underside.
characters.occupationAccent: A burgundy route-guide scarf and pale transit badge contrast with the animal's dark wings.

limits: These are species-informed fictional character palettes. Their expressive faces, relative sizes, clothing and poses remain stylized. Cephalopod display states are not fixed species colors. No ecology or learning-content changes are implied.
